## 1. One-paragraph verdict
Genuine, name-faithful fixture. My own byte-level IVF parse: DKIF v0, header len 32, fourcc AV01, 192x108, rate/scale 30/1, header frame count 18 == 18 frames parsed, 0 trailing bytes, frame sizes+headers sum exactly to the 5,459-byte file, pts strictly increasing 0..17, first OBU byte 0x12 = valid temporal delimiter (forbidden bit 0, type 2). The "g6" in the name is literally true: ffprobe per-frame pict_type = `I P P P P P I P P P P P I P P P P P` — keyframes exactly at 0/6/12, matching the consuming test's premise ("independent frames at packets 0, 6, 12", av1_differential.rs:406-407). ffmpeg 7.1.5 (the repo's pinned reference version) decodes it with zero errors.
